hmda.source: Committed HMDA New Jersey slice (data/hmda/new-jersey/county_market_summary_nj.csv), Union County row. Properties located in Union County. Not a second national download.
hmda.caveat: HMDA describes reporting institutions in the statutory HMDA universe for properties located in this county. It does not describe all lending activity. Denial rate is denials divided by applications. It is not a quality score, approval probability, or fair-lending conclusion. Disparity does not prove discrimination.

njhmfa.copy: Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000).
njhmfa.caveat: County of the property does not by itself qualify a borrower. Amounts are 'up to' and require program eligibility. NJHMFA participation is not an endorsement.

findings.title: 2025 mortgage application mix
findings.body: The committed 2025 HMDA county slice recorded 16,330 applications, 8,654 originations, and 3,058 denials for properties in Union County (18.73% denial rate, denials ÷ applications). Purchase applications were 37.15% of applications and refinance applications were 36.55%. Conventional applications were 83.63% of the county mix, with FHA 14.05%, VA 2.27%, and USDA/other 0.06%. Denial rate is not a quality score.

findings.title: NJHMFA down-payment geography
findings.body: Union is in NJHMFA's 12-county group. Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000). County of the property does not by itself establish borrower eligibility.

findings.title: Clerk research access and local housing/repair resources
findings.body: The Clerk name index covers 1977-06-01 forward in the current public index; pre-1986 image coverage is incomplete and is not a zero-record finding. Union County's Home Improvement Program and Senior Home Improvement Grant are local housing/repair resources as of the 2026-01-14 county page, not mortgage products. No structured sheriff-sale status snapshot was acquired.

lender_discovery.copy: Use the New Jersey lender catalog and the existing Union County catalog page to research lenders. A headquarters or city listed in this county does not mean the lender serves only this county. HMDA county activity is not a New Jersey license roster. Individual mortgage loan originators are not published from this page.
